svg.title: 64-word regime atlas
svg.desc: Theorem-derived classification of all 64 period-2 M/V words into four regimes.
svg.text: All formal period-2 assignments. Cells encode theorem regime, not state count.
row bits h0 h1 u0 · column bits u1 l0 l1
M=0 / V=1 is used only to place words in the 8×8 atlas; literal M/V labels remain primary.
